key_concepts: The muscular system has primary functions related to movement and daily activities.
Major muscles include the biceps, quadriceps, heart, and diaphragm.
Muscles help the body perform physical activities.
Habitats have unique physical characteristics such as landscape, climate, soil, and water.
Forests have tall trees, dense vegetation, and abundant rainfall.
Deserts are dry, sandy habitats with extreme temperature changes between day and night.
Oceans are the largest habitat on Earth, covering about 71% of the planet's surface.
Grasslands are wide-open spaces where herbivores graze.
Mountains are high-elevation habitats with rocky terrain and low oxygen levels.
Tundra is a cold, treeless habitat found in polar regions.
Wetlands are waterlogged habitats that support amphibians and birds.
Coral reefs are shallow, warm-water habitats with colorful reefs.
